provenance.frozen_protocol: quality >= .90, coverage >= .90, 4-connected components >= 4 native cells, fraction >= .05, 250 m boundary sensitivity
provenance.license: GFD is CC BY-NC 4.0; derived proxy data are not unrestricted commercial data
provenance.target_positive: ward intersects at least one accepted satellite-mapped inundation component
provenance.target_unknown: excluded upstream; never converted to a negative in this evaluation
provenance.target_zero: protocol non-detection; NOT confirmed dry and NOT confirmed non-flooded

label_audit.unknown_exclusion_note: Inferred from unique wards x events minus frozen rows. The 54 unknown rows are not present in the frozen table and cannot be individually audited here.
warnings: Zeros are protocol non-detections, not confirmed dry wards.
Only seven proxy positives exist; model comparisons are exploratory.
Static predictors cannot distinguish 2005 from 2015 rainfall.

meta.pooled_metric_policy: Raw scores from separately trained fold models are not comparable. Headline pooled metrics use within-fold percentile ranks; raw pooled scores are retained as a diagnostic only. Per-fold metrics and their macro averages are reported separately.
